```{r}
# Load Data
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
kpis <- read.csv("Northwind_Challenge_Data/northwind_monthly_kpis.csv")
complaints <- read.csv("Northwind_Challenge_Data/northwind_complaints.csv")
staff <- read.csv("Additional CGI Files/northwind_contact_centre_staffing.csv")
meter <- read.csv("Northwind_Challenge_Data/northwind_meter_reads.csv")
pilot <- read.csv("Northwind_Challenge_Data/northwind_ai_pilot_2025.csv")

```
```{r}
# Good standing metrics
good_standing <- complaints |> 
    mutate(
    # 1. Convert Excel serial numbers to dates
    date_opened = as.Date(date_opened, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    date_closed = as.Date(date_closed, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    
    # 2. Create a clean month column (snapped to the 1st of each month)
    month_opened = floor_date(date_opened, "month")) |>
    filter(floor_date(date_closed, "month") == ymd("2025-02-01"))
good_standing
```
```{r}
# Minimum targets for good standing
good_p1 <- good_standing |> filter(priority == "P1")
good_p2 <- good_standing |> filter(priority == "P2")
good_p3 <- good_standing |> filter(priority == "P3")
good_p1_time <- mean(good_p1$days_to_close)
good_p2_time <- mean(good_p2$days_to_close)
good_p3_time <- mean(good_p3$days_to_close)
print(paste0("To maintain a good standing, P1 cases should take on average ", sprintf("%.2f", good_p1_time), " days, P2 should take on average ", sprintf("%.2f", good_p2_time), " days, and P3 ", sprintf("%.2f", good_p3_time), " days."))
# Maximum breach rate
breach_rate_good_p1 <- mean(good_p1$sla_breach)
breach_rate_good_p2 <- mean(good_p2$sla_breach)
breach_rate_good_p3 <- mean(good_p3$sla_breach)
print(paste0("The maximum breach rate for P1 cases should be ", sprintf("%.2f", breach_rate_good_p1 * 100), "%, P2 should be ", sprintf("%.2f", breach_rate_good_p2*100), "%, and P3 should be ", sprintf("%.2f", breach_rate_good_p3*100), "%."))
```

```{r}
# Regulator Metrics
closed <- complaints |> filter(status == "Closed")
on_time_closure_sept <- complaints |> 
  # 1. Convert Excel date and filter for September 2026 and Closed status
  mutate(date_closed = as.Date(date_closed, origin = "1899-12-30")) |> 
  filter(
    status == "Closed",
    floor_date(date_closed, "month") == ymd("2026-09-01")
  ) |> 
  # 2. Count occurrences and calculate the breach/compliance ratio
  count(status, sla_breach) |> 
  group_by(status) |> 
  mutate(ratio = n / sum(n))
on_time_closure <- closed |> count(status, sla_breach) |> 
  group_by(status) |>
  mutate(ratio = n/sum(n))
on_time_closure_sept
on_time_closure
```

```{r}
# Combined monthly data, predicting regulator satisfaction from data we have
monthly_sla_summary <- complaints |> 
  mutate(
    # 1. Convert Excel serial numbers to dates
    date_opened = as.Date(date_opened, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    date_closed = as.Date(date_closed, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    
    # 2. Create a clean month column (snapped to the 1st of each month)
    month_opened = floor_date(date_opened, "month"),
    
    # 3. Calculate duration and check target
    duration_days = as.numeric(difftime(date_closed, date_opened, units = "days")),
    met_target = case_when(
      priority == "P1" ~ duration_days <= 5,
      priority == "P2" ~ duration_days <= 10,
      priority == "P3" ~ duration_days <= 20,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) |> 
  # 4. Group by month to calculate metrics per period
  group_by(month_opened) |> 
  summarise(
    total_complaints = n(),
    closed_on_time = sum(met_target, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_within_target = (closed_on_time / total_complaints) * 100
  ) |> 
  arrange(month_opened)

monthly_sla_summary

monthly_reopened_summary <- complaints |> 
  mutate(
    # 1. Convert Excel serial numbers to proper dates
    date_opened = as.Date(date_opened, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    date_closed = as.Date(date_closed, origin = "1899-12-30"),
    
    # 2. Create a clean month column (snapped to the 1st of each month)
    month_opened = floor_date(date_opened, "month"),
    
    # 3. Check if it was reopened and closed within 3 months of opening
    reopened_in_3_months = (status == "Closed - reopened") & (date_closed <= date_opened + months(3))
  ) |> 
  # 4. Group by month to calculate the metrics per period
  group_by(month_opened) |> 
  summarise(
    total_complaints = n(),
    reopened_on_time = sum(reopened_in_3_months, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_reopened_in_3_months = (reopened_on_time / total_complaints) * 100
  ) |> 
  arrange(month_opened)

monthly_reopened_summary
model <- lm(kpis$regulator_satisfaction_score_of_5 ~ monthly_sla_summary$pct_within_target + monthly_reopened_summary$pct_reopened_in_3_months)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# Feasibility of AI chatbot
# Cost: $640,000 per year
annual_sessions <- (4/3) * sum(pilot$assistant_sessions)
fully_contained <- annual_sessions * mean(pilot$fully_contained_rate)
fully_contained
escalated <- annual_sessions * mean(pilot$ escalated_to_agent_rate)
escalated

# linear regression for regulator score via pilot
closed_within_target <- pilot$assistant_sessions * pilot$fully_contained_rate
reopened <- monthly_reopened_summary$pct_reopened_in_3_months[4:12]
customer_satisfaction <- pilot$assistant_csat_of_5
complaint <- pilot$assistant_sessions * pilot$complaint_raised_after_session_rate
pilot_satisfaction <- kpis$regulator_satisfaction_score_of_5[4:12]
pilot_satisfaction
monthly_reopened_summary$pct_reopened_in_3_months
ai_model <- lm(pilot_satisfaction ~ closed_within_target + reopened + customer_satisfaction + complaint)

summary(ai_model)
```
